async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the CMS - Static Pages listing in the admin (use relative goto)
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/cms_page/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Open the page titled "Enable Cookies" from the pages grid
    # (the page title in the grid is usually a link to the edit form)
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Enable Cookies").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Update the Page Title field to the requested value
    # The field in the Magento admin page edit form is labeled "Page Title"
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Page Title").fill("Cookie monster coming to your place")

    # Save the page. The save button in the CMS page edit form is typically named "Save Page"
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save Page").click()
    # Wait for save to complete (networkidle or success message)
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

- There are no helper functions in the provided knowledge base, so none are used.
- Use a relative goto to the CMS > Pages listing to avoid clicking a link that navigates away as an intermediate action.
- From the pages listing, click the link for the page titled "Enable Cookies" to open its edit form.
- Locate the edit form textbox labeled "Page Title" and replace its contents with the requested new title.
- Click the "Save Page" button to persist the change and wait for the save to complete.

Utility of knowledge base functions: none were available, so all interactions are direct Playwright calls in the script.

Notes on selectors and choices:
- Used relative goto("/index.php/admin/cms_page/") to reach the Manage Pages list directly.
- Chose get_by_role("link", name="Enable Cookies") assuming the page title appears as a link in the grid (standard Magento behavior).
- Used get_by_role("textbox", name="Page Title") to target the title field in the edit form.
- Used get_by_role("button", name="Save Page") to save; waited for networkidle after clicks to ensure operations complete.
